title: Signature Packet Dots
description: Signature Packet Dots is a visualization ability in the Signature Interactive Data-Flow Animations database. Animates each packet as a dot traveling its edge. Packets spawn at the source node and ease along the edge path to the target, then despawn. It takes packet events and produces moving dots. Tunable parameters: ease in-out. Guarantee: dots never outlive their packet. This record is a Signature-authored completion — an original design of the JAH system, clearly labeled Signature, and not presented as a harvested public record.

fields.mechanism: Packets spawn at the source node and ease along the edge path to the target, then despawn.

title: Signature Throughput Ribbons
description: Signature Throughput Ribbons is a visualization ability in the Signature Interactive Data-Flow Animations database. Draws throughput as flowing ribbons whose width is the rate. Edge widths scale with the measured bytes-per-second over a rolling 5-second window. It takes byte counters and produces ribbons. Tunable parameters: 5 s window. Guarantee: ribbon width is always proportional to rate. This record is a Signature-authored completion — an original design of the JAH system, clearly labeled Signature, and not presented as a harvested public record.

title: Signature Pulse on Event
description: Signature Pulse on Event is a visualization ability in the Signature Interactive Data-Flow Animations database. Fires a pulse ring from a node whenever an event occurs there. Guarantee: rings never stack beyond 5 per node. title: Signature Stream Trails
description: Signature Stream Trails is a visualization ability in the Signature Interactive Data-Flow Animations database. Leaves motion trails behind fast-moving values.
